claims.claim: Anchor investors usually have a "lock-in" period, meaning they cannot sell their shares for 30 days.
claims.note: SEBI regulations state that 50% of shares allotted to anchor investors are locked in for 30 days, and the remaining 50% are locked in for 90 days from the date of allotment.
